title: Longest Alternating Subarray
key_insight: 遍历数组找交替子数组(差值为1,-1,1,-1...)的最长长度
approach: 线性扫描，维护当前交替子数组长度
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def alternatingSubarray(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        res = -1
        i = 0
        while i < n - 1:
            if nums[i+1] - nums[i] != 1:
                i += 1
                continue
            j = i + 1
            expected = 1
            while j < n and nums[j] - nums[j-1] == expected:
                expected *= -1
                j += 1
            res = max(res, j - i)
            i = j - 1
        return res

title: Date Range Generator
key_insight: 实现一个日期范围生成器，按步长yield日期
code_python3:
# JavaScript problem - Python equivalent
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
def dateRangeGenerator(start, end, step):
    current = datetime.strptime(start, '%Y-%m-%d')
    end_date = datetime.strptime(end, '%Y-%m-%d')
    while current <= end_date:
        yield current.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        current += timedelta(days=step)

key_insight: 用窗口函数按booking_id排序，累计乘客数不超过capacity的进入航班
code_python3:
-- SQL Solution
SELECT f.flight_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.cnt, 0) <= f.capacity THEN COALESCE(b.cnt, 0)
         ELSE f.capacity END AS booked_cnt,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.cnt, 0) > f.capacity THEN COALESCE(b.cnt, 0) - f.capacity
         ELSE 0 END AS waitlisted_cnt
FROM Flights f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Passengers GROUP BY flight_id) b
ON f.flight_id = b.flight_id

title: Count Paths That Can Form a Palindrome in a Tree
key_insight: 路径上字符能组成回文等价于最多一个字符出现奇数次，用bitmask表示奇偶性
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def countPalindromePaths(self, parent, s):
        from collections import defaultdict
        n = len(parent)
        children = defaultdict(list)
        for i in range(1, n):
            children[parent[i]].append(i)
        count = defaultdict(int)
        count[0] = 1
        ans = 0
        def dfs(node, mask):
            nonlocal ans
            for child in children[node]:
                new_mask = mask ^ (1 << (ord(s[child]) - ord('a')))
                ans += count[new_mask]
                for j in range(26):
                    ans += count[new_mask ^ (1 << j)]
                count[new_mask] += 1
                dfs(child, new_mask)
        dfs(0, 0)
        return ans

SELECT booking_id, 
       CASE WHEN rn <= capacity THEN 'Confirmed' ELSE 'Waitlist' END AS status
FROM (
    SELECT b.booking_id, f.capacity,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.flight_id ORDER BY b.booking_date) as rn
    FROM Bookings b JOIN Flights f ON b.flight_id = f.flight_id
) t

title: Election Results
key_insight: 每个投票者的票平均分配给所投候选人，求总票数最多的候选人
code_python3:
SELECT candidate
FROM (
    SELECT candidate, 
           SUM(vote_weight) as total_votes,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(vote_weight) DESC) as rk
    FROM (
        SELECT candidate, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY voter) as vote_weight
        FROM Votes
    ) t
    GROUP BY candidate
) t2
WHERE rk = 1
